comparison.objective: Insert a sink pivot rod through a stopper eye and seat its pivot ball; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Occluded rod-through-eye alignment and constrained insertion versus recessed-key insertion, counterholding, fine adjustment and relocking.
comparison.success_condition: Verified rod-eye engagement, ball seating and stopper motion versus two acceptable impacts and stable collar setting.
comparison.reason: The common insertion primitive is generic; plumbing linkage engagement does not test response-based parameter tuning. Candidate omits numeric rebound, overload, drift and tightening criteria.
